primary_predictors.ecological_role: amount of mapped terrestrial breeding options near the site
number of Antarctic Ecosystem Inventory Habitat Complexes within 2 km
local topographic relief available around the breeding site

decisions: Tier 2 richness retained; Tier 2 Shannon sensitivity-only.
Ice-free area and Tier 2 richness remain separate primary dimensions.

context_only: absolute REMA elevation until geoid correction
sensitivity_only: 1 km and 5 km versions of breeding-option traits
explicitly_not_added_before_outcomes: additional static melt, temperature, precipitation, wind or insolation predictors from the same AEI classification inputs
literal island area or mainland distance until a separately validated landmass lane is available
any trait chosen because it correlates with penguin abundance trend
rationale_for_no_extra_abiotic_block: The Tier 2 Habitat Complex classification already integrates continental-scale abiotic structure including temperature, melt, precipitation, wind, insolation and terrain. Adding those source variables as co-primary static predictors before outcomes would multiply partially redundant hypotheses. Regional/time-varying environmental forcing belongs in the demographic model, not in the frozen site-architecture predictor set.

missingness_rule.rule: Do not widen the 2 km radius or impute primary breeding-option traits to rescue these four sites. Primary models using breeding-option predictors use complete site-level predictor cases; terrain-only diagnostics may retain all 122 sites but are not co-primary.

modeling_order: within each species, estimate each primary site predictor in predeclared single-predictor-plus-structure models before any combined model
fit a three-predictor combined model only as secondary synthesis if diagnostics permit
cross-species synthesis compares standardized effect direction and magnitude; unqualified pooled species interaction is not primary
terminal_rule: No additional primary site trait may be introduced after demographic outcomes are opened. New traits require an external-data justification and a new paper/revision contract.
